title: Croatian Milk Pudding
description: A rich and silky Croatian dessert featuring condensed milk, made in one pot and egg-free friendly. It is a perfect treat for any time of the day.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together the condensed milk, whole milk, and cornstarch.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the pudding has thickened.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the unsalted butter, vanilla extract, and salt.
Let the pudding cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate until chilled.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of salt if desired.
